name: Five-stage method with substance under each stage
useWhen: A repeatable method has four or five stages and each stage genuinely has activities and deliverables worth naming — the audience needs to see the depth, not just the sequence.

focal.note: Flat by design. Nothing competes with the headline because the panels are doing volume, not display. A giant ordinal here would fight 45 lines of second-level copy.

replacesNote: process-timeline-v1 has no second level at all, so a five-stage method with real substance flattens to five one-line cards. Do not retire it until this has been through a real deck — v1 is still right when the stages genuinely are one-liners.

deviations.why: Unsanctioned ornament, and redundant with the ordinal and reading order.
The source ran out of room. Reproducing that would be copying a defect.
